def split_and_shuffle(names: list[str], first_half: bool, seed: int = 42) -> list[str]:
    """Split names into two equal groups and shuffle."""
    mid = len(names) // 2
    subset = names[:mid] if first_half else names[mid:]
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    rng.shuffle(subset)
    return subset
